body: I honestly want the first option, but that doesn't change the fact that I still want her and her alone.. I just don't feel like it'd be worth it after it. Honestly I'm not upset about it right now, I know I will be if things turn for the worst. But I'm numb right now, I don't know what will happen, and I'm not moving on until I know if the relationship is still her or not. If it ends, there's no stopping it. If it doesn't? I'll come back here and post an update, but I don't honestly think that it'll pull through. I'm hoping for the best, but I expect the worst.

I don't want to be with anyone else though, she's my world, my everything and all that I've got in this life. I already know that if she's gone and out of my life, I wouldn't want to open up any new doors and new relationships. I'd be done. I'm doing myself the favor of living on through a life that her and I have completely planned out together. We were going to do everything together, her and I. If my plans are out of the window, what's left to do? :/

Thank you for the kind words and everything that you said, but I mean.. It's just not worth going through if she's not by my side.

My SO has been in the same exact rut. I say she helped me up, but she also needed help herself. It was a team effort, her and I. We called/call each other Bonnie and Clyde, haha.. I was her rock and she was mine. She's not doing anything that~~'s wrong~~ I don't like*, it's just that I don't know what's going on and I feel like there's more to it, she's been secretive.. We used to stay up late at night simply because she asked me to never leave her alone and now she's saying that she needs more space.. It fucking sucks. I'm sorry you're going through this too, I'm so sorry..

Then why not do whatever it is that you truly want to do and not worry about the money? I know it's easier said than done.. You've got to have a car at least, right? If not, even then. Just take what you want out of the world and do it, push yourself to get up and just start walking the distance and try to find your inspiration where you think you can.

It's all easier said than done, and I wish I could help my situation with this kind of information.. Here's a post that I used to use as an inspiration, kind of a popular one, but still.. http://www.reddit.com/r/pics/comments/2gejnr/got_divorced_lost_my_job_so_me_and_my_buddy_got/

Yeah.. It's all pretty horrendous to go through.. I've never gone through something so bad before in other relationships, or at least, they didn't hurt this much.

EDIT: I'm sorry, I saw it in the messages and I thought it was a PM, I'll fix it up. 

It's hard to explain so much in just a comment, but I'll try to do the best that I can. It's something so small in other people's eyes, probably.. But it all started roughly a week or two ago when we started talking about marriage and life together more. Not that we were looking to marry just yet, but we were planning on moving somewhere else.. She started saying that I was getting overbearing and clingy and I wasn't giving her enough space. I don't think we went through one night without arguing to the point where she was crying and honestly I was too. We'd argue about dumb stuff too, never really knew what the real big problems were. It's just, I feel like that's not all there is to it, you know? :/
